def oracle(input):
    n = input['n']
    offers = input['offers']
    by_end = {}
    i = 0
    while i < len(offers):
        s, e, g = offers[i]
        if e in by_end:
            by_end[e].append([s, g])
        else:
            by_end[e] = [[s, g]]
        i += 1
    dp = [0] * (n + 1)
    i = 1
    while i <= n:
        best = dp[i - 1]
        arr = by_end.get(i - 1, [])
        j = 0
        while j < len(arr):
            s, g = arr[j]
            val = dp[s] + g
            if val > best:
                best = val
            j += 1
        dp[i] = best
        i += 1
    return dp[n]

            d -= 1

            ans = best[i][0]
        i += 1

title: maximum-possible-number-by-binary-concatenation

def oracle(input):
    nums = input
    a, b, c = nums[0], nums[1], nums[2]

    def bitlen(x):
        n = 0
        while x > 0:
            n += 1
            x //= 2
        return n

    def concat(x, y):
        ly = bitlen(y)
        return x * (2 ** ly) + y

    def value(order):
        r = order[0]
        r = concat(r, order[1])
        r = concat(r, order[2])
        return r

    perms = [
        [a, b, c],
        [a, c, b],
        [b, a, c],
        [b, c, a],
        [c, a, b],
        [c, b, a],
    ]

    best = value(perms[0])
    i = 1
    while i < 6:
        v = value(perms[i])
        if v > best:
            best = v
        i += 1
    return best
